instruction: Retrieve the tab that was closed a moment ago.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (quora.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 knowledge/content websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_open_tabs_info) can extract all open Chrome tabs with their URLs
Metric (is_expected_tabs) properly compares expected vs actual tab URLs using URL comparison
Complete coverage: checks all 3 tabs are present (wikipedia, medium, quora)
Correct verification logic: if agent reopened quora.com, all 3 URLs will be present; if not, only 2 URLs present and evaluation fails
No state timing issues - tabs remain accessible after agent action
Expected values are semantically correct for this task
